checks.name: active encounter feedback is visible and input-transparent
feedback draws below existing HUD
actual enemy registration creates screen-space health and suppresses 3D labels
duplicate registration cannot duplicate damage callbacks
real fractional cannon damage shows exact HP loss
health bar shows remaining and maximum numeric HP
damage trail preserves previous HP briefly
cannon numbers are larger than automatic rounds
continuous fire merges short burst as unrounded actual sum
shell and automatic damage remain separate
later burst begins a new number
individual shells never merge
overkill only displays HP actually removed
fatal damage keeps zero-HP bar briefly
defeat reward is separate from damage
dead hits and repeated defeat cannot duplicate damage or reward
zero-HP bar expires without hiding surviving damage numbers
floating damage and reward have bounded lifetimes
number formatting keeps whole values clean and necessary decimal
positive tiny damage is never shown as zero
shared blast centre keeps damage anchored to separate victims
separate blast victims have separated projected damage
dense fire has fixed 48-number memory cap without changing actual totals
invalid and zero damage never generate floating numbers
paused hides feedback and freezes its presentation time
quitting hides feedback and freezes its presentation time
visible menu hides feedback
visible map hides feedback
title or loading screen never shows enemies
sightseeing without encounters hides combat feedback
SceneTree pause hides feedback even if host flag is false
closing overlays restores valid gameplay feedback
visible enemy in front of camera has a projected bar
rendered enemy anchor follows movement between throttled LOS scans
real world wall hides both HP and new damage text
removing wall restores real line of sight
vehicle collision layer also occludes enemy feedback
enemies behind the camera never project into view
off-screen enemies are not clamped onto screen edges
unengaged distant enemies do not clutter the view
actual automatic lock promotes distant visible target
module lock is also displayed from actual status
optional explicit lock can be supplied by the host
crowded layout keeps lock first and caps bars
crowded enemy bars never overlap each other
crowding hides overflow instead of drawing unreadable labels
stationary layout is stable between frames
custom HUD exclusions displace or hide bars without overlaps
screen-space bars keep their pixel size with distance
unregister disconnects and restores original 3D feedback
freed enemies leave no retained references
world reset clears damage counters and restores enemy labels
feedback teardown hides detached enemy without querying stale transforms

scope: isolated production feedback, actual enemy damage, Jolt walls and Camera3D projection; no full city or save access
